# Web.Headers

```m
Web.Headers(url as text, optional options as nullable record) as record
```

Returns the HTTP headers downloaded from the url as a record value.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/web-headers)

|---|---|---|
| `url` | `text` | no |
| `options` | `nullable record` | yes |
